# Reconcile — llms.txt
# Machine-readable site description for LLM-powered crawlers and assistants.
# See https://llmstxt.org/

# Replace BASE_DOMAIN with your actual domain before publishing.

> Reconcile is an agentic bookkeeping control room for small operators.
> It ingests bank transactions via Plaid, categorises them using a Groq large language model
> running inside a LangGraph workflow, routes them to human review or automatic posting,
> and syncs approved entries to QuickBooks. Every agent decision and human correction is
> recorded in a full audit trail. Access requires authentication; no public read content exists.

## Key capabilities
- Bank transaction ingestion (Plaid)
- AI-powered vendor categorisation with learned memory (Groq / LangGraph)
- Human-in-the-loop review queue with bulk actions
- Ledger synchronisation (QuickBooks)
- Full audit trail and agent decision evidence log
- Per-user data isolation

## Access
- Login required for all features
- No public signup at this time
